2,175 likes, 51 comments - hindash on September 22, 2026: "The ultimate foundation for sensitive, reactive skin is here. The @tower28beauty Swipe Serum Foundation is the skin safe foundation that performs.
I used shade 14.5 Redondo on @deemakhaled 
Available at @sephoramiddleeast 
With medium, buildable coverage and a natural second-skin finish. 16 hour long wear. Non-comedogenic + non-acnegenic. Fragrance free.
I paired this with the Swipe Serum Concealer in “14.0 PV” and the new Big Blender Brush and Baby Blender Brush.
Available in 36 inclusive shades.
#Tower28 #SwipeFoundation #hindash".

posts.meta_description:
2,384 likes, 91 comments - hindash on September 4, 2026: "Enter L’HEURE BLEUE - @guerlain ‘s Blue Hour 💙
The new fragrance, with notes of Iris, vanilla, orange blossom wrapped in an ozonic accord. Inspired by the coolness of blue hour. 
A revisited jewel by @delphinejelk. Fresh, modern and timeless. 
Also featured are 3 limited edition Rouge G jewel cases.
BLEU ICONIQUE features a beautiful enamel effect.
BLEU ASTRAL features a dazzling rhinestone gradient. 
BLEU REVERIE features printed fabric with golden touches.
Available now.
Model: @melissa__kov 
#Guerlain #GuerlainFragrance #LHeureBleue #GuerlainLover #BlueHour".
